items.alt: A bandaged captain’s hand opens a cockpit door, symbolically releasing a Flydubai jet from a dark spiral into clear skies.
Jasprit Bumrah stands beside fallen Sri Lankan wickets and a score of 45, facing Pakistan’s green wickets and the gold-medal final ahead.
Jorge Jesus points to an empty Portugal bench seat marked 7 as Cristiano Ronaldo strides out of the training camp carrying his kitbag.
Esteban Ocon holds his helmet beside a folding chair marked Reserve?, while racing seats marked Taken line the 2027 Formula 1 grid.
